name: arrow-chase
description: Monorepo for Arrow Chase. Root scripts only orchestrate; backend/ and frontend/ build and deploy independently.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix e2e ci
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.build: node scripts/mvnw.mjs -B -q -DskipTests package && npm --prefix frontend run build
